title: Final Magnetization Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the expression for magnetization M as a function of external magnetic field B.

title: Convexity Principle Statement
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately state the convexity principle of free energy in thermodynamics.

title: Second Derivative Check
description: Important Criteria: The student must compute the second derivative of the free energy with respect to M and check its sign for convexity.

title: Thermodynamic Implications
description: Important Criteria: The student must discuss the implications of violating the convexity principle with a relevant example.

title: Correctness of Units
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units in their calculations are consistent and correctly applied.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or misinterpretation of the conditions for M.
